newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Seven stocks fell, four rose and five were flat in a 6.9-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday with the WIG 20 index closing at 1,649.3 points, 0.4 percent lower than at the regular session.
The remaining seven stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 1.6 percent to 155 zlotys in a 29.1-million-zloty turnover.
More details should be available later today on WSECONT.
